prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1196; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported pain and swelling in the right knee. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact described. Over the course of sixteen visits, treatment followed a standard conservative pathway, including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and anti-inflammatory medication. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned.

Examination findings were mixed. Palpation produced localized tenderness and some effusion, which support the reported injury. Ligament stability testing and neurovascular checks were within normal limits. The patient's records also note a minor strain to the same area several years earlier, which resolved fully without lasting limitation.

Billing review identified one service entered twice for the same day. The treating provider confirmed that the second entry was a duplicate and not a separate encounter.
